import os, re

# Load demo pairs
d = os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR']
t = open(d + '/../../sessions/' + os.path.basename(d) + '.jsonl').read().replace('\\n', '\n')

# Simple grid parser
all_grids = {}
pattern = re.compile(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n(.*?)\n', re.DOTALL)

for mo in pattern.finditer(t):
    region_type = mo.group(1)
    nr, nc = int(mo.group(2)), int(mo.group(3))
    grid_text = mo.group(4).strip()
    grid_rows = [row.split() for row in grid_text.split('\n')[:nr]]
    grid = [[int(x) for x in row] for row in grid_rows]
    all_grids[region_type] = grid

print("GRIDs FOUND:")
for k in sorted(all_grids.keys()):
    g = all_grids[k]
    print(f"\n{k} ({len(g)}x{len(g[0])}):")
    for row in g:
        print(row)
